Sub: Intimation under Regulation 30(6) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015 – Audio recording of conference call on the quarterly financial 
results of the Company. 
 
Dear Sir/Madam,  
 
This is with reference to the captioned subject and our letter dated October 14, 2026, the Company 
had organized a conference call for analyst and investors on the Unaudited (Standalone & 
Consolidated) financial results (Q2FY27) of the Company for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 
on Monday, October 19, 2026 at 15:00 Hrs. (IST). This call was hosted by ICICI Securities Limited. The 
audio recording of the conference call has been made available on the website of the Company at 
https://jindalsaw.com/docs/Jindal-Saw-Q2-FY27-Audio-Recording.mp3 
 
This is for your information and records. 
 
Thanking you, 
Yours faithfully, 
 
For Jindal Saw Limited,
